title: Royal Aviation Museum of Western Canada
representedDate: Current May 2022 museum building and its permanent exterior.
geometryBasis: Native museum building way 1044672921, shared address with named campus way 1298193366, and exact north-facing doorway 11841783427.
sectionBasis: Museum owner documents the three-storey glazed northwest triangle, wing-shaped canopy and hangar gallery. The architect and contractor document the steel frame, metal panels, glazing and single-storey hangar with mezzanine.
limitations: The native building and entry fix the footprint and orientation. Roof fold, eave heights, canopy, windows, panel widths and airside openings are estimates based on the written architecture and current footprint.
The existing terrain field is preserved. Door thresholds, foundation depths and nearby paving are approximate. Aircraft, interiors, vehicles and other buildings are outside the model scope.
